meta.title: Working Memory icon exploration
meta.anchor: A local-first macOS utility that preserves the thread of thought so founder/coders can resume deep work quickly.
meta.selection_basis: Delegated selection adjusted by the required similarity screen.

selected_logo_route.label: Thread Through Snapshot
selected_logo_route.rationale: The thread passes behind a snapshot boundary and returns in front, expressing captured context becoming resumed work without relying on a generic AI or letterform symbol.
selected_logo_route.best_for: macOS Dock, Finder, app switcher, and the 40-point in-app header tile.
selected_logo_route.decision_advice: Use the simplified deterministic construction with one white frame and one periwinkle thread; preserve the over-under layer order at every size.
selected_logo_route.watch_out: Keep the frame and thread bold enough that the crossing remains visible at 16 pixels.
selected_logo_route.next_step: Package the three vector foreground layers in Icon Composer and validate Default, Dark, Mono, and legacy macOS rendering.

rejected_directions.label: Folded-W Memory Thread
rejected_directions.reason: Rejected after the similarity screen found materially close live blue-gradient app icons using a white folded W ribbon.

rejected_directions.label: Capture / Resume Loop
rejected_directions.reason: Too close to generic sync and automation symbols.

rejected_directions.label: Interlocking Continuity Links
rejected_directions.reason: Reads more like collaboration or link management than cognitive continuity.

rejected_directions.label: Memory Bridge
rejected_directions.reason: Clear silhouette but less product-specific and easily confused with a generic wave.

rejected_directions.label: Nested Thread
rejected_directions.reason: Drifts toward chat, email, and at-sign metaphors.

avoid: brains, circuits, nodes, timers, documents, clouds, chat bubbles, sparkles, and literal AI imagery
baked shadows, bevels, glows, or masks in source artwork
close derivations of supplied reference icons

caveats: Generated concepts are directional; the selected app artwork is rebuilt as deterministic vector geometry.
The similarity screen is a basic visual search, not formal trademark clearance.
